name: Luna 25
intro: Privet! I'm Luna 25, the first Russian Moon lander in 47 years.
I'm heading near the south pole, north of Boguslawsky crater, to look for ice.
There are two backup sites too, near Manzinus and Pentland A.
First I need a final engine burn to lower my orbit.
briefing: The engine burn is lasting longer than planned...
Choose where to land while we still can!
fact: Luna 25 crashed two days before its planned landing, after an engine burn lasted too long.

alarm.title: Engine Overburn
alarm.alarm: ENGINE BURN TOO LONG — ORBIT TOO LOW
alarm.briefing: The engine fired 127 seconds instead of 84! In real life Luna 25 crashed. Choose a site and rewrite history!
